integrity: An exact finite discrete Morse matching, signed integral boundary and signed Lefschetz character are reproducible with the bundled standard-library Python checker. Self-review only; no independent validation or independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for the standard 16-vertex five-regular Clebsch graph and cutoff two; no uniform formula for larger folded cubes or other cutoffs. The symmetry statement concerns the integral homology action, not an equivariant homotopy equivalence. A differently indexed prior equivalent remains a bibliographic risk.
title: The Clebsch two-independence complex is a four-sphere with a sign character
